mainTopicBrief: 本单元 Reading 讲黄河、尼罗河与智慧灌溉如何滋养文明。仿写训练精选课文金句，练‘so...that 结果状语、转折对比、with 短语’的句式迁移。

items.focusType: so/such + that 结果状语从句
items.focus: 用 ‘such + (a) adj. + n. + that + 结果’ 表达‘如此……以至于……’，让程度与因果一气呵成。
items.original: Without doubt, the Yellow River will continue to bring such agricultural abundance to China that life without its priceless gifts would be unimaginable.
items.cn: 毫无疑问，黄河将继续为中国带来如此丰饶的农业物产，以至于没有这些无价馈赠的生活将不可想象。

models.en: The lecture was so inspiring that many students resolved on the spot to devote their lives to science.
Her kindness left so deep a mark on us that, years later, we still speak of her with gratitude.

items.tip: such 修饰名词、so 修饰形容词/副词，两者都可接 that 引出结果。

items.focusType: 转折纠错 many think... but...
items.focus: 先摆出‘许多人以为’的常见看法，再用 but 亮出事实，纠正误解、突出观点。
items.original: Many think of the Nile as an Egyptian river, but it flows through many countries.
items.cn: 许多人把尼罗河当作埃及的河，但它其实流经许多国家。

models.en: Many regard success as a matter of luck, but behind it usually lie years of quiet effort.
Many picture scientists as cold and distant, but the best of them are driven by wonder and love.

items.tip: ‘纠错式’开头很适合议论文点题：先立靶(常见误解)，再破靶(事实真相)。

items.focusType: With the help of... 介词短语开头
items.focus: 用 ‘With the help of + 手段/工具’ 开头作方式状语，引出借助某物完成的动作。
items.original: With the help of algorithms, farmers can decide exactly how much water each field needs.
items.cn: 借助算法，农民能精确判断每块田地需要多少水。

models.en: With the help of online courses, students in remote villages can now learn from the best teachers.
With the help of a simple notebook, she turned her scattered ideas into a clear plan.

items.tip: With + 名词短语可表方式/条件；若要强调‘一……就……’可换 Once 引导从句。
